entities.name: French Fashion Dominance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Louis XIV made fashion a tool of state power — Versailles set trends that all European courts imitated. Fashion dolls (pandoras) were sent to foreign courts to showcase French styles. Paris became the world's fashion capital.
